_comment: T-31 0.2.11 third-party gate (scripts/check-third-party.mjs, npm run check:third-party [-- --flavour release|owner]). The bundled set is DERIVED from the electron-builder config (package.json build + scripts/builder-selftest.cjs + afterPack + the esbuild bundle), so a new root is covered automatically. `files`: EXACT path -> licence id; a bundled file not listed here (or matched by a glob below) is UNMAPPED, even beside listed files. Paths are as bundled: repo-relative for in-repo files, build/renderer/... for the esbuild output, node_modules/... for npm packages, bundled:<pkg> for packages esbuild inlines into app.js, models/... for the afterPack default avatar, rooms-video/... for the owner videos. `globs`: only for first-party code and the vendored Laneboard tree; each states the matched `count` and `listSha256` (sha256 of the sorted matched paths joined by newline) so an added, removed or renamed file fails until a human re-verifies it. `unverified`: exact bundled files whose licence/terms are not confirmed: owner flavour WARNs (prints the list), release flavour FAILs. Add an entry ONLY for an asset whose origin and licence were verified (evidence listed). `noticeKey` = text that must appear in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md; `mustContain` = licence text (whitespace-insensitive) that must be in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md when the packed copy ships no LICENSE file or esbuild strips it; `version` = the version the credit row names (must equal node_modules). ROUND 3: npm packages shipped through extraResources are listed PER FILE (glob rules with count + listSha256, exact entries for files whose terms differ); `globs` are matched in order and a file belongs to the FIRST glob that matches it, so list a specific glob before a broad one. `signatures` name components that can hide inside another file (content regex over shipped node_modules files, or a path regex); a file that carries one must map to a licence whose `embeds` lists it and whose `mustContain` terms ship in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md. `nonNpm: true` = not an npm package credit (no npm version/licence-file check; the terms must be in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md). `ownerOnly` = files that must be ABSENT from the release bundle (OWNER-ONLY-LEAK fails otherwise). Only the flavour being run is counted: release counts what the release build packs, owner what the owner build packs. OWNER-ATTESTED (T-31 0.2.11, 2026-10-26): "attested" maps an exact path to {status:"OWNER-ATTESTED", attestation:{source,quote,event,note_id,date}}; it counts as verified in both flavours ONLY when all five attestation fields are non-empty strings, else ATTESTATION-INCOMPLETE (hard fail). The 5 room plates (AI-generated, resources-pinned/room-v2/room.json) carry the owner statement of 2026-10-26 (board event owner record); an earlier attestation (owner record) that named a different generator was WITHDRAWN. The statement covers the room images only, so the 7 room videos (rooms-video/*.mp4, owner build only) are NOT covered and stay UNVERIFIED (owner flavour WARN; they are absent from the release bundle). OPEN LEGAL (T-31 0.2.11): "openLegal" lists legal items still open ({id,item,status,detail,needs,closure?}). An item is closed ONLY when closure.{closed,evidence,note} are all non-empty strings. Flavour public: every open item is a hard FAIL. Flavours release (npm run dist, the owner's own installer) and owner: a WARN, so the owner build is never blocked. ATTESTATION PIN: every "attested" entry carries the sha256 of the attested file; the gate recomputes it and a missing or different sha256 is ATTESTATION-STALE (hard fail, every flavour).
